name: Nepheg
overview: Nepheg is a male member of the tribe of Levi, identified specifically as the son of Izhar. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical, serving to trace lineage within the Levitical family. There are no additional notes or details about his life or role beyond this lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Nepheg means 'sprout' or 'shoot,' reflecting a Hebrew proper name with agricultural imagery. This meaning is noted in the scriptural reference Exodus 6:21, though the name is not indicated to have been given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Nepheg as the son of Izhar, establishing his place within the Levitical genealogy. Beyond this explicit father-son relationship, no other family connections are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Nepheg's significance lies in his role within the genealogical record of the Levites, which is important for understanding the heritage and priestly lineage established by God. His mention in Exodus 6:21 situates him within the broader narrative of God's covenant people and the organization of the priestly tribe. Although not highlighted for specific deeds, Nepheg contributes to the continuity of the Levitical line through which God’s service in the tabernacle was maintained.
